variant.rationale: The complete Isaac V2 contact/actuator audit covered all 169 admissible cmu104 start phases and found 981 first-motor-tick hard-safety failures on the prior 95-percent/two-degree corpus. The maximum first-tick velocity excess was 337782 microradians per second on an 8000000 limit; reducing the authored cap from 95 to 90 percent adds 400000 microradians per second of measured reserve. A 12-degree knee/elbow lower reserve exceeds one 60 Hz step at the new worst-case elbow cap (180000 microradians) by 29440 microradians. A five-degree positive bilateral hip-roll floor addresses the only reset-window contact pair, left thigh against right thigh near start frame 159. These fail-closed projections require a fresh native and Isaac audit and are not learned-quality thresholds.
